title: Lagged CME Bitcoin futures total-open-interest growth for BTC long or cash
thesis: Strictly positive weekly growth in regulated CME Bitcoin futures total open interest may identify a participation state in which full-capital BTC exposure has better fee-adjusted risk economics than unconditional buy-and-hold.
mechanism: For each eligible CFTC Tuesday report, divide Open_Interest_All by the exact prior Tuesday Open_Interest_All and subtract one. Make the state usable only seven calendar days after the report at 00:00 UTC; hold BTC while growth is strictly positive and zero-yield cash otherwise until the next eligible weekly update.
economic_rationale: The rule treats total open interest as a participation and risk-bearing regime rather than directional positioning. It must preserve sufficient BTC upside while reducing drawdown and underwater opportunity cost; positive aggregate return without Calmar, breadth, concentration, holding and terminal-inventory support is a failure.
